verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API, webhooks, an MCP server, and note-editing endpoints, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back user-defined automations. API path versioning (/api/v1) and the round-trippable note Markdown are adjacent features, not automation version control. The axis is a fair question for a workflow-capable SaaS tool, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
